_comment: The view library: every angle, framing and head shot a full-character LoRA needs, at the scale it will be rendered. `prompt` is natural language for the image model; `tags` is the caption the dataset prep writes for that view, so the two never drift apart. Kinds: `body` (full figure, 1024x1536), `cowboy` (head to mid-thigh, native rather than cut out of a body view), `upper` (head to waistband, native), `face` (head and shoulders with the top's neckline and collar IN frame - the 2026-09-23 change: faces cut at the collarbone taught a top with no collar on every face crop of three trainings), and `detail`, which is empty here because a garment close-up is per character (`details` in character.json). A character selects views by key (default: all). Each view carries its own `background`, rotating through neutral fields so the background never correlates with the trigger (2026-09-21).
